original.statement: The InfluxDB v1 metrics provider configuration has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and will prevent Traefik from starting if present.

corrected.statement: Traefik v3 removed the InfluxDB v1 metrics provider, so the static configuration key metrics.influxDB is gone. That configuration is now unsupported and would stop Traefik from starting.

decision.reason: [ev-a8010075f3de] says the InfluxDB v1 metrics provider was removed in v3. It shows this as Traefik static configuration in File (YAML `metrics: influxDB`), File (TOML `[metrics.influxDB]`) and CLI (`--metrics.influxDB`) form, not as a Helm chart values key. So the subject is the config-key metrics.influxDB, not a helm-value. The change type "removed" is right, because the text says this configuration is no longer supported.
